stories.title: Judge sentences Anderson Co. man to another 180 years on top of life sentence for woman's murder
stories.summary: An Anderson County judge sentenced Jason Dockery to an additional 180 years for charges related to the murder of Shysti Mayberry.

stories.title: UMC's Holston Conference and Foundation staff to relocate from Alcoa office to separate Knoxville facilities in December
stories.summary: The Hoston Conference of the United Methodist Church said the conference and foundation staff will relocate to separate buildings one mile apart in North Knoxville.

stories.title: DOJ: Three East Tennessee-based government contractors pay more than $1M after improper use of PPP loans
stories.summary: The DOJ said Firewater Associates, LLC, Lancaster Services, Incorporated and Manhattan Legacy Services, LLC all agreed to pay settlements.

stories.title: Zoo Knoxville introduces 'Jacobs Pass' program for Knox County Schools families
stories.summary: Zoo Knoxville has launched the Jacobs Pass Program, granting Knox County students and their families free zoo access, honoring Glenn Jacobs' commitment to education.

stories.title: Second Harvest Food Bank announces times for Knoxville holiday drive-thru distribution ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Officials with Second Harvest Food Bank of East Tennessee said they will host their annual drive-thru distribution at Redemption Church on Nov. 18.

stories.title: Knoxville woman creates game-day piñatas for Vols fans
stories.summary: Her latest design features a familiar face from UT football history, former head coach Lane Kiffin.

stories.title: Tiny home community in Sevierville adds guided cave tours to guest experience
stories.summary: Guests at Sojourn Lodging can now explore a cave system discovered beneath the property, complete with wildlife and unique limestone formations.

stories.title: Sun Country Airlines set to begin first commercial service from McGhee Tyson Airport in May
stories.summary: Sun Country Airlines will offer low-fare, twice-weekly nonstop flights between Knoxville and Chicago O'Hare International Airport, McGhee Tyson staff said.

stories.title: Kazakh national accused of being part of ransomware group that extorted schools, hospitals in 6 states, including Tennessee
stories.summary: Roman Khlynovskiy, extradited from Italy, faces charges in Tennessee for allegedly engaging in a data extortion campaign with the "8-Digits Team."

stories.title: Newport Grammar School teacher taking zero-gravity flight
stories.summary: Phillip Lewis is headed to France for the once in a lifetime chance to fly on a zero gravity flight

stories.title: 'They're not just numbers' | Knoxville families remember loved ones killed in traffic crashes
stories.summary: At Knoxville's World Day of Remembrance, a mother shared her son's story as police reported fewer traffic fatalities but more crashes resulting in injuries in 2026.

stories.title: How new shot clocks are being funded at Knox County Schools' gyms
stories.summary: Knox County basketball teams have kicked off the season with the KOC Tip-Off Classic, raising funds to install shot clocks ahead of a new TSSAA mandate.
